newsitem.title: JAPAN: Bandai ask-only on forecast and rating revision.
newsitem.headline: Bandai ask-only on forecast and rating revision.

text.p: Bandai Co Ltd shares were ask-only in early morning trade on Friday, depressed by a recent downward revision in its business forecast as well as rating, brokers said.
As of 0033 GMT, the shares were ask-only at 2,380 yen after closing at 2,460 yen on Thursday.

"On Thursday, the shares racked up the maximum loss allowed for one day, due to a downward revision in its business prospects for the year to March 31, 1997," a trader at a second-tier brokerage said. "The downward trend continued on Friday after Daiwa Institute of Research cut its rating."
Before the market opened on Friday, Daiwa downgraded Bandai to a "C" rating from its previous "B", Daiwa Securities brokers said.

In its three-grade rating system, the research institute assigns a "C" rating to issues whose values it expects to underperform the Tokyo Stock Exchange first-section TOPIX index by more than 10 percentage points over the next six months.
